endorsements.name: KaiJern @xwings Lau
endorsements.label: 3 Years in China: A Tale of Building a REAL Full Speed Anti-Censorship Router
endorsements.description: Reversing GFW (Great FireWALLl) is not a new topic, but it evolved over the years. Especially these past 3 years, things have changed and the WALL has become greater and stronger. As a person staying in China since 28th Jan 2020, this talk is to share the knowledge behind and over the WALL. Final goal is to reach the full capacity from the ISP and to gain access to the world. 2. Different types of WALL. Not only for outgoing traffic to real internet, but internally too 3. Method to bypass and intro to different protocols 4. Deployment method, which clinent/server to choose from (v2ray, xray, clash and etc) 5. Certain tricks that sometimes do not work 6. Journey to start building a home router 7. DEMO and Quick video tour of the system At the end of this talk, tools and firmware (non zh_cn mod) will be uploaded to Github. It will be free and open source. Hopefully these tools, firmware and experience are able to help those still suck behind the wall (eg, Iran).
endorsements.assessor: HITB (Hack In The Box Security Conference)
